steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Give a client a choice: good, better and best on one estimate.

steps.caption: Search for the client
steps.narration: On Clients, search for the client.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Open their page.

steps.caption: Options
steps.narration: Under Estimates, choose Options on the estimate.

steps.caption: Option name
steps.narration: Type the first option's name.

steps.caption: Total
steps.narration: Give it a total.

steps.caption: Description
steps.narration: And say in a line what the client gets.

steps.caption: Show the total to the client
steps.narration: Tick Show the total to the client, so they see the price.

steps.caption: Add option
steps.narration: Choose Add option.

steps.caption: Second option
steps.narration: Add the next one the same way.

steps.caption: Total
steps.narration: This one costs a little more,

steps.caption: Description
steps.narration: for a thicker plank and a quieter floor.

steps.caption: Show total
steps.narration: Tick Show the total again.

steps.caption: Recommended
steps.narration: And tick Recommended on the one you want to stand out.

steps.caption: Add option
steps.narration: Then Add option again.

steps.caption: The list of options
steps.narration: Both options are listed, and Better is marked recommended.

steps.caption: Close
steps.narration: Close the list.

steps.caption: Preview
steps.narration: Then choose Preview to see the estimate the way your client does.

steps.caption: Choose your option
steps.narration: Under Choose your option, the client sees both, with the recommended one marked.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Go back to the CRM.

steps.caption: Menu: Clients
steps.narration: You'll find your clients, and their estimates, under Clients in the menu.

youtube.title: How to offer good / better / best options | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of estimate options in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will open Options on a client's estimate, add a Good and a Better option with a total and a description, mark one recommended, and preview what the client sees.
